evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, resolveLauncher still builds the bound launcher path with lexical resolve() only (`const absolute = ... resolve(candidate)`), so symlinks are retained. The surrounding contract comment says that this single bound path is used for the certification probe and later launches, while the containment guard separately checks a canonical path. A workspace symlink to an outside launcher can therefore pass containment and later be retargeted to workspace code before spawn, executing workspace code on the host. Canonicalizing once at resolution with realpath and failing closed on canonicalization failure is the smallest compatible fix; this is an implementation defect in the intended launcher containment behavior, not merely optional hardening.
